minor.issue: Volume/issue/pages (2022;56(11):616-621) not verifiable from the source, which is the epub version (Br J Sports Med 2022;0:1-7).
Single sentence with no sample, setting (10 Georgian 'Big 10' clubs) or result.
Omits hand-held dynamometer, six ranges, Poisson model and covariates (age, club, BMI).
Omits the 41 kg extension cut-off (71% true-positive, 46% false-positive), a key practitioner-relevant result.
Tackle technique, rule enforcement and concussion-recognition elements are reasonable but not derived from the study.
Generic post-concussion guidance; does not state that the study did not examine return to play.
Could note the end-of-season dropout was mainly due to international competition (136 players) and that the study was powered on total neck strength, not extension.

note: Both state the core IRR correctly and avoid causal claims, but B adds verifiable setting, model, covariates and the 41 kg threshold with its false-positive caveat and the 71% vs 68% discrepancy, while A omits these and pads practical fields with unsourced advice.
